name: agentable
description: Deterministic CLI to assess repository agent readiness with Agentable

scripts.build: npm run clean && node scripts/bundle-frontend.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/ensure-bin-permissions.mjs
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync('test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync('tsconfig.test.tsbuildinfo', { force: true });"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check:max-lines && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test test-dist/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='dist/**' --test-coverage-lines=75 --test-coverage-branches=65 --test-coverage-functions=80 test-dist/*.test.js
